propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared kernel, selecting each built-in/project criterion at most once while respecting effective disables and file applicability.

Project LLM criteria must select by effective globs; disabled or non-applicable criteria execute zero times with stored reason provenance, while project DET criteria execute through detector selector outside the LLM fan-in.
Budget enforcement: positive authored usd_budget is enforced and shed units recorded; omission stays uncapped; zero is schema-invalid.

After one local criterion call fails, retain successes and continue independent criteria; blocking-capable missing coverage returns unsigned INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists; advisory-only missing coverage may pass.

Legacy and new deterministic projections must be computed from the same calls during expand-contract and recorded with comparison mismatches; approved differences limited to effective disable/retune, project DET inclusion, applicability, budget enforcement, and partial-failure verdict policy.

Authored code-review.yaml topology, base-reviewer summary, one-hop Round B, per-overlay context, model-ladder resolution, sequential scheduling, and absence of checkpoints must remain unchanged; versioned discovery trace persisted internally only, not in response or status projection.
